description:
Hello dear dance lovers welcome to

✨WILD EMBRACE ✨

5Rhythms & Nature Dance Retreat with 
Live Music
Aljezur Essencia - May 11 - 16

5 days of workshops in studio and in nature with live music. 

This retreat counts for 30 hours of Waves as prerequisites onto the 5Rhythms teacher training path.

• 5RHYTHMS® movement practice
• NATURE & OCEAN EXPLORATION
• ECSTATIC DANCE
• LIVE MUSIC
• VEGAN CUISINE
• SAUNA & LAKE
• DIGITAL DETOX
• ECO RETREAT CENTER


Deepening the maps of the 5Rhythms from Gabrielle Roth: Flowing, Staccato, Chaos, Lyrical and Stillness immersed in connection with nature.  


Facilitation by Guillaume Laplane (FR)

Live music by Andréa Sampalmieri (IT) drums and Pablo Mesguen (FR) Guitare & piano. 


5 days retreat fees from 300€

short_description: A 5-day 5Rhythms® & nature dance retreat with live music in Aljezur. Immerse in movement, ocean explorations, and deep connection to yourself and nature. A playful, introspective journey through the 5Rhythms maps in a supportive, eco-conscious setting.
